It lets you build the class timetable, mark the academic calendar of the school
year (terms, holidays, public holidays and free-disposal days) and spread the
syllabus of each subject across the available sessions, with a Gantt chart
showing both the planned and the actual progress. It runs entirely inside the
browser: **no data is sent to any server**.

[Open full screen](../../apps/planificador/index.html){target="_blank"} ·

::: {.column-screen}
<iframe id="planificador-frame" src="../../apps/planificador/index.html"
        title="School planner"
        style="width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 140px);min-height:600px;border:0;display:block"
        loading="lazy"></iframe>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// keep the embedded planner in sync with the site theme
(() => {
  const frame = document.getElementById('planificador-frame');
  if (!frame) return;
  const detect = () =>
    document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark') ? 'dark' :
    document.body.classList.contains('quarto-light') ? 'light' : null;
  const send = () => {
    const t = detect();
    if (!t || !frame.contentWindow) return;
    frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'planificador-theme', theme: t }, '*');
  };
  frame.addEventListener('load', send);
  send();
  new MutationObserver(send).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## How the data is stored

All information is stored only in the browser of whoever uses the tool, and can
be exported to and imported from a JSON file under **Settings → Backup**.

The planner is also a single self-contained HTML file: once downloaded it can be
opened by double-clicking on any computer, with nothing to install and no
internet connection. The downloaded copy keeps its data separately from the copy
on this page.
:::
